name: -8AN to 7/8-20 Short Carburetor Inlet Fitting
title: -8AN to 7/8-20 Short Carburetor Inlet Fitting
description:
The -8AN to 7/8-20 Short Carburetor Inlet Fitting is engineered for demanding high-performance automotive fluid systems. ColorFittings Short Carburetor Inlet Fittings are precision-engineered to connect AN braided fuel lines directly to your carburetor's fuel bowl inlet, providing a secure, leak-free solution for carbureted fuel systems where space is limited in racing, street performance, and marine applications.

Technical Specifications:
• Origin: Precision CNC-machined in the USA.
• Material & Finish: Premium high-grade construction with corrosion-resistant coating.
